work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief LI confirms the Calcutta vicariate apostolic, derogates from Paul V’s grant to Mylapore and declares the vicar sole ordinary of Bengal; LF9208 esse → LF9261 ac permanere across L’s note, LI’s provenance and running title LF9211–9258; complete 4 August 1835 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF9179–9179; the source closing at LF9348–9351 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die quarta augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pon- tificatus Nostri anno quinto. . Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
